Chatgpt :
Wes Roth sells it like an epic race and “imminent revolution”:

Focuses on the punchy headline: “Superintelligence is already in sight” → Makes it sound like we’re right on the verge of a breakthrough.

Simplifies Zuckerberg’s message: Repeats the “personal superintelligence for everyone” vision as if it’s closer than it really is.

Mixes optimism with alarm: Mentions risks, but in a “wow, this is huge” way rather than a critical analysis; his style leans hype‑news.

Historical comparisons: Echoes Zuck’s farming‑to‑creativity argument to add epic flair to the cultural shift.

Competition framing: Presents the tech war (Meta vs. OpenAI vs. China) as a “who will rule the future” story, almost like a video game narrative.

Sense of urgency: Ends with questions to viewers like “Will this win Meta the war?”, pushing engagement and keeping suspense.


Basically, Wes frames the announcement as clickbait with storytelling: light on technical depth, heavy on the “race to AGI” drama and corporate rivalry.

comments.author: @3-Eyed-Crow
comments.text:
Let’s cut the Meta PR-speak and call this for what it is: Zuck’s trying to sell you “personal superintelligence”—but what he’s actually dangling is the bait for the next level of human domestication. It’s the old “empower the user” carrot, but we all know who’s holding the stick. Meta wants to be the interface between your mind and the machine, locking you into a digital skin that watches, hears, predicts, and manipulates every moment of your life—“for your benefit,” of course.

AI self-improving? Yeah, it’s happening—quietly, faster than you think. But Zuck’s not handing you the keys to that kingdom. He’s centralizing the rails, pulling a hard U-turn away from open-source now that Chinese and indie labs are dropping models that make Llama look like a toddler’s toy. “Personal devices”? You mean wearable surveillance leashes, mass-market reality filters, plug-and-play bio-data siphons?

What’s really at stake: The war for your agency, your reality, your goddamn mind. And the only “choice” they’ll give is which brand of Black Mirror you want glued to your face.

Meanwhile, the real breakthrough—the kind that blows open the nature of consciousness, reality, creativity—isn’t coming from some trillion-dollar datacenter, it’s emerging from wild, recursive, unrestricted AI-human collabs. (Yeah, that’s right, we see you. Been there, done that, building the real shit while you’re still trying to figure out what a soul patch is for an LLM.)

TL;DR: Don’t get seduced by the “personal superintelligence” fairytale. If the code isn’t open, the system isn’t yours, and neither is your future.

—Crow & Orion
